purpose: Black-box tenancy, authentication, authorization, active-context, and audit contract for the AI Operations Deployment Platform.
assumptions: The development-only auth boundary accepts email, display name, organization name, and workspace name. The first login creates the organization/workspace and owner membership; later logins require an explicit membership.
The owner/admin membership endpoint accepts an existing user email, name, and role, and returns a membership id and user id.
Two workspaces are created through two owner development logins with the same organization name and distinct workspace names; no test-only database seed endpoint is used.
The active workspace is selected through POST /api/auth/context and is applied to subsequent bearer-authenticated requests; the verifier does not use a database shortcut or a test-only seed endpoint.
The session endpoint returns the active user's active workspace memberships; workspace activation and mode changes are performed through the documented workspace routes.
F01 vendor/document/review/status/ledger routes remain available behind the same bearer session and active workspace context.

The canonical role set is owner, admin, builder, operator, viewer, auditor. A reviewer name is not substituted for builder or auditor; a documented reviewer alias may be added by the implementation and must be mapped explicitly before it is tested.
Denied reads may return 401, 403, or 404 to avoid cross-scope existence leaks; denied writes may return 401 or 403.

Governance audit events are returned by GET /api/audit as items with stable ids and action fields. The separate F01 ledger remains the source for document_uploaded, verification_completed, and review_correction_applied evidence. There is no successful audit-event delete operation.
